article.story: ATLANTA -- — Nasir Whitlock scored 29 points, Georgia Tech shot 50% from 3-point range and the Yellow Jackets held persistent Georgia Southern at bay in the end for a 95-83 win on Friday. Whitlock made six baskets and 13 of 14 foul shots and fellow starters Kam Craft, Colby Garland and Tylis Jordan each scored 11 for Georgia Tech (2-0). Truman Claytor IV scored 24 points, Eltramon Smith scored 20 points, reserve Josh Dixon 13 and reserve Dallas Gardner 11 for the Eagles (1-0). Garland made two foul shots with 7:12 left before halftime to give the Yellow Jackets their first double-digit lead, 33-23. Even though Georgia Southern stayed within striking distance for the duration they never managed a lead. Georgia Tech and Georgia Southern met for the ninth time in program history. Georgia Tech leads the all-time series, 7-2, including a 6-1 mark at home. The Yellow Jackets have a seven-game win streak over the Eagles dating back to 1960. Georgia Tech won last year's game at McCamish Pavilion, 68-66. Up next Georgia Southern: Hosts Mercer on Tuesday. Georgia Tech: Hosts Eastern Kentucky on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
